scope: Ještěd’s standing mountain hotel, restaurant, transmitter and attached summit gallery above Liberec.

originalReview.notes: The exact Qualla photograph shows the cylindrical glazed restaurant, twin rows of hotel windows, white laminate hyperboloid, silvery upper shell and slim antenna mast. The city specifies the 33 m main body and 94 m height.
